paragraphs: EXAMPLE PARAGRAPH — this is not a real application. I am writing to Example Studio about the Frontend Developer role. I build responsive, scalable and maintainable interfaces, and I treat a clear UX/UI as part of the work rather than a separate step.

EXAMPLE PARAGRAPH — at eXplorins I worked as a FrontEnd Developer with Angular 19 and TypeScript, using DDD and Playwright for end-to-end tests. I also built a Benetton application on a REST API and a dashboard that made the data understandable. At Forvis Mazars I used React 19 and TypeScript on an internal platform, including code review for a team of four.

EXAMPLE PARAGRAPH — alongside that work I shipped bocabla.com, an educational Next.js app that now serves more than 80 clients. On my own time I have kept studying: CS50x from Harvard, software training at Platzi, and the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure AI Foundations certificate. I would bring the same frontend focus to Example Studio: interfaces people can use, and code other developers can maintain. Thank you for considering this example. I would be glad to talk about how I can help the team.
